subject: Coupa onboarding: Atlas Components unable to accept supplier invite
messages:
From: Samantha Torres <samantha@atlascomponents.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Problem accepting Coupa supplier invite - error 403

Hi Monica,

We received your Coupa supplier invite this morning but when I click the link and try to create an account I get a 403 / access denied page (screenshot attached: coupa_error_403.png). We are on corporate SSO (Okta) and our Okta admin says Coupa is attempting to redirect to an SP that we don’t have configured.

Because of this we can’t complete the onboarding form and I can’t see the PO in our portal. Can you either:
- resend the invite with an option to create an account using our email (not SSO), or
- provide the SP metadata (ACS URL / Entity ID) so our Okta admin can add the integration, or
- if simpler, create a manual vendor record on your side so we can receive the PO and invoice.

We’re trying to avoid delaying the April shipment.

Thanks,
Samantha Torres
Vendor Operations | Atlas Components
attachments: coupa_error_403.png

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Torres <samantha@atlascomponents.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Problem accepting Coupa supplier invite - error 403

Hi Samantha — thanks for flagging, and sorry for the hassle.

Quick checklist so we can unblock you ASAP:
1) Can you confirm the exact legal entity name you use for invoicing and the domain for your Okta account (e.g., atlascomponents.com)?
2) Try opening the invite link in an incognito/private window or a different browser (sometimes SSO cookies cause redirect loops).
3) I’m attaching the PO we issued (PO-78321.pdf) so you have the reference while we sort access.

If the SSO route is easier for you, we can provide our SP metadata to your Okta admin — Karthik, can you prepare the Coupa SP metadata and the expected Entity ID/ACS values?

If neither option works, we can create a temporary manual vendor record so the PO is on file and payments won’t be blocked. Please let me know which you prefer; we’re aiming to have invoicing enabled before 2026-04-27 so finance can process Net30.

Best,
Monica Patel
Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference
attachments: PO-78321.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Problem accepting Coupa supplier invite - error 403

Forwarding the thread — Atlas Components (Samantha) is hitting a 403 on the Coupa invite. They use Okta and say the SP isn’t mapped.

Action items:
- Karthik: please pull the Coupa SP metadata (Entity ID, ACS URL, any fingerprint) and send to Samantha’s Okta admin.
- Dev: can you whitelist the vendor domain atlascomponents.com on our provider side if there are any outgoing redirection checks, or confirm there’s no tenant misconfiguration on our Coupa tenant?
- Lauren: flag this for finance — if the vendor can’t onboard by 2026-04-27 we should consider creating a manual vendor entry and placing the PO on hold with a note.

Thanks — keeping this as high priority.

Monica

From: Samantha Torres <samantha@atlascomponents.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Okta Admin <okta_admin@atlascomponents.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Problem accepting Coupa supplier invite - error 403

Hi Monica / Karthik,

We can add the SP config on our side but we’ll need the following values from Redwood/Coupa: ACS URL, Entity ID (Audience), and the certificate/fingerprint if available. I’ve copied our Okta admin (okta_admin@atlascomponents.com).

As a short-term workaround we can also accept invoices outside the portal if you can create a manual vendor record and confirm the PO number on our side. I’m attaching an updated W-9 for your vendor file (atlas_w9_v2.pdf).

Let me know the SP metadata or if you prefer us to switch to the email-based creation flow for the invite.

Thanks,
Samantha
attachments: atlas_w9_v2.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Torres <samantha@atlascomponents.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Problem accepting Coupa supplier invite - error 403 (next steps & DocuSign)

Thanks Samantha — I’ve opened an IT ticket and Karthik shared the SP metadata with your Okta admin privately. Two parallel items to keep this moving:

A) Workaround (fastest): switch the invite flow to "Create an account with email" when you open the invite link — steps: click the invite, select "Use email instead of SSO", enter the address samantha@atlascomponents.com, verify email, then complete the supplier onboarding form. If you don’t see that option, let me know and I’ll re-issue the invite from a different tenant flag.

B) Longer-term (SSO): your Okta admin should add the SP with the ACS and Entity ID we provided (I copied Karthik on the ticket). Once SSO is configured you’ll be able to manage multiple users via Okta.

I’ve also sent a DocuSign link for the vendor onboarding packet (W-9 + vendor agreement + tax forms) — please complete that first so finance can finalize the vendor record. DocuSign: https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&acct=1234&ppid=abcd

When you complete either the email-flow onboarding or the DocuSign, reply here and I’ll confirm the PO is visible in your portal and that nothing is blocking payment.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Monica Patel
Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference
